title: Exhaustive search for DNA binding sites of Basillus subtilis transcription factor YsiA by KaScape method
authors: Bing-yao Huang; Mia Huang; Hong Chen; Xiao-dong Su
one_liner_zh: 该文用KaScape高通量方法穷尽搜索枯草杆菌转录因子YsiA的DNA结合位点并绘制能量图谱，虽聚焦TF-DNA互作但方法为实验技术而非AI或物理模拟，故得中档分。
abstract: Basillus subtilis ( B. subtilis ) YsiA is also known as FadR is a pre-formed dimeric repressor to regulate fatty acid degradation. However, the knowledge about double-stranded DNA(dsDNA) binding sites of YsiA in the whole genome level is limited so far. In this report, we have applied a newly established high-throughput method, KaScape, to exhaustively study the relative binding sites and energy landscape of YsiA and confirmed the resuls with gel-shift experiments. We’ve found that half-binding site is enough for YsiA to bind with dsDNA. Besides detecting the known consensus sequence which is bound by YsiA, we have also detected other minor binding site sequences through the KaScape method. It thus demonstrates that KaScape can be used to study dimeric transcription factors (TFs) in general.
abstract_zh: 枯草芽孢杆菌（B. subtilis）YsiA，亦称为FadR，是一种预先形成的二聚体阻遏蛋白，用于调控脂肪酸降解。然而，目前关于YsiA在全基因组水平上双链DNA（dsDNA）结合位点的知识仍十分有限。在本报告中，我们应用了一种新建立的高通量方法——KaScape，来全面研究YsiA的相对结合位点及能量景观，并通过凝胶迁移实验验证了结果。我们发现，半结合位点足以使YsiA与dsDNA结合。除了检测到已知的YsiA结合共有序列外，我们还通过KaScape方法检测到了其他次要结合位点序列。因此，这证明了KaScape可普遍用于研究二聚体转录因子（TFs）。
